text:
Liam H: Quick question000flew in for a partner meetup and used an airline voucher for part of the fare, paid taxes/fees on my card. Corporate card failed for one dinner and I lost the receipt. Also have an airport lounge invoice with VAT. How to file?
Jo (People Ops): Thanks Liam. Short: submit the lounge invoice + itemized dinner receipt if you find it; if lost, use a lost-receipt attestation with manager approval. For voucher travel, attach the itinerary showing voucher usage and the card charge for taxes/fees.
Liam H: The voucher shows as a zero fare in the airline PDF and taxes = $42. Should I upload the whole itinerary PDF?
Finance Ops Bot: Yes. Upload the itinerary/pdf showing voucher usage and the card charge. In the expense form choose "Award/Voucher travel" and set Payment Type = Personal Card (reimburse) for the taxes/fees. No extra approval unless taxes > $500.
Nora M: For the lost dinner receipt, what's the minimal attestation?
Jo (People Ops): Use the lost-receipt template: date, vendor, amount, attendees (if client), short reason. Manager approval required. Example below:

```
Lost receipt attestation
Employee: Liam H
Date: 2026-11-02
Vendor: Osteria Verde
Amount: 78.60 EUR
Reason: receipt misplaced after card decline
Manager approver: Nora M
```

Liam H: Lounge invoice has VAT (ES). Do I need to do anything special for VAT?
Finance Ops Bot: Keep original VAT invoice. Upload it and mark as "VAT included". Finance will reconcile VAT. If you later get a partial VAT refund, update the claim.
Liam H: One more 000naming files?
Jo (People Ops): Use YYYYMMDD_vendor_shortamount_currency, e.g., 20261102_Osteria_78.60_EUR and 20261102_Lounge_24.50_EUR_VAT. Put attestation files with _attest.
Liam H: Thanks, uploading now and tagging @Nora M for approval.
Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: tag "expenses-lost-receipt" for attestation items. Receipts older than 60 days need exception.
Nora M: Approved for the dinner attestation. Will add a manager comment in the expense system.
